mentions.h: P.W. "Jimmy" Green: A man of many talents
mentions.note: presented to the Queen before the 1948 Poly Marathon

photos.c: Left: It's Poly Marathon day, 19th June 1948, and her Majesty The Queen is introduced to some of the runners before they set out on their 26 mile journey from Windsor to Chiswick. Cecil Ballard, of Surrey A.C. is presented to Her Majesty with "Jimmy", no. 31, next in line.

photo.caption: Left: It's Poly Marathon day, 19th June 1948, and her Majesty The Queen is introduced to some of the runners before they set out on their 26 mile journey from Windsor to Chiswick. Cecil Ballard, of Surrey A.C. is presented to Her Majesty with "Jimmy", no. 31, next in line.
